lxc_f975cdc9e45097b8.text: Imagine you have done the same job well for fifteen years.

lxc_7e913ee9c0b7361d.text: One day, new software arrives, and the way you work changes.

lxc_4ae3b6dcf8482e92.text: It is, but it may not be enough.

lxc_0262f5097aadef7c.text: This topic is about career longevity, which means having a long and healthy working life.

lxc_77f9f85185e5f1cf.text: You will learn the difference between reskilling and upskilling.

lxc_fa2ad868943ca52c.text: You will also see why every job now needs some technology skills, and why human skills still matter.

lxc_3df84f29ab4f3e58.text: Finally, you will see how workers, employers and teachers can build a learning plan together.

lxc_2b3dc52408128643.text: Upskilling means getting better at your current job.

lxc_ee056b149d154d6f.text: You add new skills so that you can do the same work in a stronger way.

lxc_84aa8eb644af2636.text: Reskilling means learning skills for a different job or role.

lxc_ac3ed809e294320a.text: Lifelong learning is the bigger idea behind both.

lxc_d6cbde4ddc0bf281.text: It means you keep learning for your whole life, not only at school.

lxc_1e36d761342f24e6.text: AI is changing work and the skills workers need.

lxc_1e8936b1bfda1c2e.text: Reskilling and upskilling with digital skills help workers learn new technologies.

lxc_1391791af73de1fe.text: It stays useful because it gets updates.

lxc_f7228e1e7e14c626.text: If it never got an update, it would slowly stop working well.

lxc_55b803005cd1bb6f.text: Many people think technology skills are only for engineers or programmers.

lxc_faddce2b6a4ef0c3.text: That idea is no longer true.

lxc_9f75b5dfaeb13df9.text: Every job now needs some tech literacy, which means a basic ability to understand and use technology.

lxc_5ef7589aa03033c6.text: It also needs adaptability, the ability to change when new technology arrives.

lxc_fd0f84f2b15a78ec.text: Maria works in a small hotel.

lxc_0681fd28a5b87332.text: Today, she uses an online booking system.

lxc_d12bc45412bef5f4.text: She is not a tech worker, but she still needs tech skills.

lxc_6aa56728a2d1e104.text: What can we learn from this example?

lxc_d9afe9b1b84eb4d0.text: What lasts is the habit of learning the next tool quickly.

lxc_8529589ffd0e033f.text: So adaptability is not an extra skill for a few people.

lxc_552e781c9585ac44.text: It is a basic skill for everyone.

lxc_7270cf358cbf1c74.text: If machines can do more, are human skills less important?

lxc_6e5240c4f2d36524.text: They value human skills like communication, attention to detail and leadership very highly.

lxc_59d823d58185ffc4.text: Each of these skills does useful work.

lxc_a9146fe9cba85308.text: Communication helps a team share ideas and solve problems together.

lxc_cc945ce4f836c469.text: Attention to detail means noticing small mistakes before they become big ones.

lxc_42e60d89714c5849.text: Leadership means guiding other people and helping a group move in one direction.

lxc_3b733348cf4a7004.text: Here is one way to understand this.

lxc_1f1454c8e5c8ecef.text: Technology can give you a fast tool, but people still decide how to use it.

lxc_091a1c1329f6dfc5.text: Someone has to explain a new system to a team, and someone has to check the result.

lxc_cb05241352c5b7ed.text: Someone also has to lead the change.

lxc_7fd81b9b9ac87244.text: So a strong career plan does not choose between technical skills and human skills.

lxc_a6d1486296cff5c3.text: Learning helps your career more when other people can see it.

lxc_f094777e6dd0f8b9.text: There are several ways to show it.

lxc_0300612865352099.text: On-the-job training means learning while you work, often from a colleague or a manager.

lxc_c12eb78d2217f123.text: Certifications are official proof that you have passed a test or finished a course.

lxc_1c2c7e2251e54adf.text: Digital badges are small online records that show a skill you have learned.

lxc_d856aa84a4cf2b7b.text: Employers can also use digital credentials, which are online records of your learning, to track a worker's progress.

lxc_4e488c294302aaab.text: A credential works like a stamp in a passport.

lxc_76ff6cc8461cd409.text: Each stamp shows a place you have visited.

lxc_3bb067593f1ec8f0.text: Each badge or certificate shows a skill you have learned.

lxc_d570208f5248ef64.text: However, a certificate is not the end of learning.

lxc_2ff6d6280eb552bd.text: Because work keeps changing, one certificate today will not cover every need in the future.

lxc_a2f979c7ccf4a757.text: Reskilling is easier when people do not do it alone.

lxc_39cfa599d2ab24af.text: Lifelong learning is supported best when employers, educators and workers work together.

lxc_7a5a26f331f95a94.text: Employers can identify the skills they will need in the future, offer tailored training (training made for a person's needs), and use digital credentials to follow progress.

lxc_41efd1164b53c7e0.text: Clear pathways for upskilling and reskilling help workers adapt and reduce the risk of job loss.

lxc_1e3b5057b8ce1466.text: A pathway is like a map with clear steps.

lxc_048f44d7653aa645.text: Without a map, a worker may feel lost.

lxc_92a20ad72e474c0d.text: With a map, they can see where they are and what to learn next.

lxc_feeb615c2faa7f99.text: You can start your own simple map.

lxc_ad10e50ccdbba35b.text: First, write the skills you already have, both technical and human.

lxc_185fa4a56d59eb92.text: Next, look at a job you want and write the skills it needs.

lxc_2fe14f0379251264.text: The gap between them shows what to learn next.

lxc_69d2ebb6f942e689.text: Finally, choose a way to learn it, such as on-the-job training, a course or a certification.
